description: T1 — Behavior-preserving CSS extraction. Move the :root token block into web/tokens.css and ALL other CSS from both inline <style> blocks of web/index.html into web/styles.css, in exact source order, then replace the inline blocks with <link> tags. Also move share.js's static injected #share-link-btn CSS into styles.css and delete the JS injection. The default (dark) theme MUST remain visually identical. This feature is a prerequisite for FEAT-002 and is independent of it.
steps: Before editing, save the pre-change CSS for the parity check: run `git show HEAD:web/index.html > /tmp/index_pre.html` so the old inline <style> blocks can be diffed against the new files.

Create web/tokens.css containing ONLY the :root { ... } block copied VERBATIM from web/index.html lines 28-58 (all design tokens AND the 'Legacy aliases for JS-generated HTML' sub-block). Do not alter any value. Keep the leading design-system comment if desired.

Create web/styles.css containing ALL other CSS, in exact source order to preserve cascade/specificity: first the first <style> block's rules EXCLUDING the :root block (index.html lines 59-1498), then appended after them the entire second <style> block's rules (index.html lines 1521-1572, including .loading-banner, .spinner, @keyframes spin, and its reduced-motion @media guard). Preserve the shipped quick-wins CSS intact: the :focus-visible rule (~line 1474) and the prefers-reduced-motion @media blocks in both sections. Do NOT drop, reorder, or alter any rule in this feature.

Move the static #share-link-btn + #share-link-btn:hover CSS from web/share.js (the injected <style>, ~lines 200-224) VERBATIM into web/styles.css (append at the end). In web/share.js, delete the `const style = document.createElement('style')` block and its `document.head.appendChild(style)` call. Leave the literal color values as-is in this feature (tokenizing happens in FEAT-002).

In web/index.html <head>, after the FontAwesome link (line 21) and before where the first <style> began (line 23), add: `<link rel="stylesheet" href="tokens.css?v=1">` then `<link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css?v=1">` (tokens before styles, both after the Leaflet/FontAwesome/Fonts CDN links to preserve the effective cascade).
Remove both inline <style> blocks from web/index.html entirely: the first (open line 23 through </style> line 1499) and the second (open line 1520 through </style> line 1573).

Bump share.js cache-buster in web/index.html (line 1695) from `share.js?v=5` to `share.js?v=6` because share.js content changed. Leave all other ?v= values untouched (tokens.css?v=1, styles.css?v=1 are new).
Run the parity verification (see verification list) and record the brace counts and selector-diff result in this FEAT's findings.
Serve web/ locally and confirm dark-theme visual parity, then commit locally on develop (e.g. `git add web/tokens.css web/styles.css web/index.html web/share.js && git commit`). Never push.
acceptance_criteria: web/tokens.css exists and contains exactly the :root block (tokens + legacy aliases), values unchanged.
web/styles.css contains every non-:root rule from both former inline blocks plus the moved #share-link-btn rules, in original source order; the first-block rules precede the second-block rules.

web/index.html has no <style> blocks (count 0), has the two new <link rel=stylesheet> tags for tokens.css?v=1 then styles.css?v=1 after the CDN links, and still contains the .scanlines DOM node and the #map::after vignette untouched.
web/share.js no longer creates/appends a <style> element; share.js?v= is bumped to v=6 in index.html.
Selector-set diff between the old inline blocks (from /tmp/index_pre.html) and the new tokens.css+styles.css is empty (no rule dropped, none added, order preserved).
Opening-brace count of tokens.css+styles.css equals the pre-change baseline (~193) exactly (pure extraction adds/removes nothing).
Default dark theme renders visually identical to pre-change when no wms_theme is stored; DevTools Console is clean.
Changes are committed locally on develop; nothing pushed.
verification: Selector-set diff: extract selectors (lines matching a trailing '{') from the pre-change inline blocks and from web/tokens.css + web/styles.css, sort both, `diff` them -> MUST be empty.
Brace parity: `grep -c '{' web/tokens.css web/styles.css` summed == baseline brace count of the old inline blocks (~193).
`grep -c '<style>' web/index.html` -> 0 ; confirm `tokens.css?v=1` and `styles.css?v=1` <link> tags present and ordered; `grep -n 'share.js?v=6' web/index.html` present.
`node --check web/share.js` passes; confirm no `appendChild(style)` remains: `grep -c 'appendChild(style)' web/share.js` -> 0.

Browser: `cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000`, open http://localhost:8000/ with no wms_theme in localStorage and dark OS pref -> dark UI identical to before (glass panels, bubble bar, legends, popups, loading spinner, share button); Console clean.
findings: T1 complete, behavior-preserving. BRACE PARITY: pre-change baseline (old inline blocks from /tmp/index_pre.html: first block lines 24-1498 + second block 1521-1572 + share.js injected CSS) = 195 opening braces; after extraction tokens.css=1 + styles.css=194 = 195. EXACT MATCH (the plan's ~193 was an estimate; the authoritative count against the real HEAD snapshot is 195==195). SELECTOR-SET DIFF: extracted selectors (lines ending in '{') from old combined inline CSS vs new tokens.css+styles.css, both sorted -> diff EMPTY (195 selector lines each). No rule dropped, added, or reordered. node --check web/share.js passes; appendChild(style) count in share.js = 0. index.html: <style> count = 0; <link> tags present and ordered tokens.css?v=1 then styles.css?v=1, placed after the FontAwesome/Leaflet/Fonts CDN links (current lines 23-24); share.js?v=5 bumped to v=6 (line 166). FILE LAYOUT: tokens.css holds ONLY the :root block (tokens + legacy aliases, values UNCHANGED); :root count in styles.css = 0. styles.css order = first-block rules (ex-:root) then second-block rules (.loading-banner/.spinner/@keyframes spin + its reduced-motion @media at ~line 1442) then moved #share-link-btn + :hover appended verbatim (still hard-coded literals). Quick-wins intact in styles.css: :focus-visible (2 matches) and 2 prefers-reduced-motion @media guards. Local python3 -m http.server browser spot-check could NOT be run in this environment (harness blocks background servers); structural proofs above are the authoritative T1 gate. NOTES FOR FEAT-002: (1) .scanlines CSS rule + its reduced-motion opacity guard are present in styles.css (grep '.scanlines' -> 2) and the <div class="scanlines"> DOM node is still in index.html (1) -> V3 must remove the CSS rule, the reduced-motion guard, and the DOM node (expect brace count -2 after V3). (2) #map::after vignette present in styles.css (1) -> V3 keeps it in dark, reduces in light. (3) #share-link-btn in styles.css uses hard-coded #93c5fd / rgba(8,20,45,0.82) / rgba(59,130,246,0.16) / rgba(6,182,212,0.3) -> V1 tokenizes these. (4) index.html line references shifted: index.html is now ~178 lines (was 1710); CDN links end at line 21, new <link>s at 23-24, </head> at 26, scanlines DOM at 29, share.js at 166. V1 adds FOUC inline snippet + theme.js <script> in <head> after line 24, and #theme-toggle-btn markup. (5) --accent-color value is red (#f87171) and read by JS-generated HTML -> do not retint for V2.
